plans.goal: Seize high terrain and establish firing dominance over the mine mouth
steps: Move the squad to elevated positions on the left side
Suppress enemy positions from high ground advantage
Focus fire on Edda Crowe, the leader, to break their morale

atoms.text: Advance to the high terrain on the left side for shooting advantage
Set overwatch positions on the barricade and prepare to control the engagement
Focus fire on Edda Crowe, the leader, to break their coordination
Suppress Rook's archer fire with coordinated attacks
Maud, stay covered but ready to heal anyone who takes fire
Shift fire to isolate and eliminate each enemy one by one

plans.goal: Break through the barricade with aggressive assault before enemies organize defense
steps: Push forward directly through the cart barricade
Target Edda Crowe and eliminate her immediately
Suppress supporting enemies with focused fire

atoms.text: Pip, dash forward around the barricade to threaten them from the side
Move through the carts, use them as cover while advancing
Strike Edda Crowe with everything we have, don't let her command
Keep Grist and Pell suppressed with covering fire
Maud, move with us and be ready to heal on the move

plans.goal: Use fire and explosives to force enemies out of position and eliminate them isolated
steps: Move to ignite the lamp-oil barrel for area denial
Force enemy dispersion away from barricade
Attack isolated enemies who lose cover coordination

atoms.text: Get to the lamp-oil barrel and set it on fire to disrupt their positions
If enemies are near the flames, shove them into the fire to spread chaos
As they scatter from the flames, focus fire on isolated targets
Target Edda Crowe before she can regroup her forces
Keep the fire area between us and enemies, use it as a barrier
Maud, stay back from the flames and prepare heals
